{{Quote|How can anyone be so wrong all the time?|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="marvel83" />}}
'''Harlech''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of the [[Drogheda Royal Guard]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drogheda/Legends|Drogheda]]. He was the personal shield and closest confidant of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Sarna (Queen)|Sarna]], and led her forces against a [[Drogheda Revolutionaries|popular revolutionary force]] that aimed at replacing the [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]] with a [[Democracy/Legends|democratic]] government in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. He was present for the conclusion of the war at the [[Drogheda Citadel]], when offworld [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] attempted to take Sarna hostage as the rebels stormed the palace. However, Harlech decided to attempt a coup, ordering his men to kill both Lando and his Queen. Before the action could take place, the revolutionaries surrounded them, telling Harlech to stand down. Although the rest of his men had already surrendered, Harlech decided to go down fighting. However, as he brandished his blaster, he was cut down by a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] blast, depriving him of a heroic last stand.<ref name="marvel83" />
